title: Rename Crate/CrateItem to Collection/CollectionItem in apricity-data and the nameCounters keys
description:
## Intent
Finish the vocabulary change that design/vocabulary.md lists as still open: `Crate`/`CrateItem` → `Collection`/`CollectionItem`, and the matching `nameCounters` keys. Collection is the DAW word (docs/glossary.md already defines it); crate stays only as the sampling-culture gloss.

## Scope
- Rust types, JSON field names and GraphQL names in crates/apricity-data; the Python side if any parity remains.
- Clean break: no aliases, no old-name readers (project rule).
- Update design/vocabulary.md, docs/glossary.md and any feature file that says crate.

## Why now
The kit-presets initiative (apricitus-5562e0, M4) exports a collection as clip files and a rack, and needs the final word before it names commands and folders.

## Verification
`git grep -niw crate -- crates web docs design features ':!Cargo*' ':!**/Cargo.toml'` shows only the glossary gloss; `cargo test -p apricity-data` green.
